OpenTrack.//RequireHttps: Set true to force HTTPS (redirect + HSTS). Leave false for a trusted-LAN plain-HTTP deployment. See docs/DEPLOYMENT.md.
OpenTrack.//Email: Set Enabled=true and fill in an SMTP server to send confirmation/password-reset email. Left disabled, those emails are logged (with any link) instead of sent.
OpenTrack.//Ai: Optional AI assist (Anthropic Claude). Set Enabled=true and provide an Anthropic API key to turn on features like smart triage. The key is billed to your Anthropic API account, which is SEPARATE from any Claude subscription. Prefer setting the key via an environment variable or user-secrets rather than committing it. See docs/AI_ASSIST.md.
